diagrams.title: Three phases, same as Section 4
diagrams.caption: Three phases, same as Section 4. ① The three analysis agents don't need each other, so they run together. ② The planner needs the top themes, so it waits. ③ The writer needs everything. Then code — not an LLM — checks the brief.

In phase 2 it passes an NPS context block to the action planner. In phase 3 the report writer turns all four reports into the NPS brief, which plain Python then fact-checks. All tools read one survey CSV through pandas, loaded once." style="max-width:100%;height:auto;display:block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
